rosterStatus: Inherited candidates; serving versions and access not verified in this revision

main-models.title: E1: static repair
main-models.note: Implemented. Separate whole-object and finishing stages; SR/F1/ER/DR use S1 and FR uses S0.

main-dynamic.title: E2: normal assembly and recovery
main-dynamic.note: Implemented normal-qualified recovery uses independent matched runs, not causal forks.

main-paired.title: E3: strict paired outcomes
main-paired.note: Planned shared-prefix study. Only genuine cloned-prefix pairs enter CRR or the paired difference.

main-ablations.title: E4: evidence ablations
main-ablations.note: Planned matched-sensor comparison; change one factor and report actual images.

static-errors.title: E5: static families
static-errors.note: Implemented breakdown; fit only families with static support; do not pool controls.

dynamic-errors.title: E6: dynamic families
dynamic-errors.note: Implemented breakdown; do not infer detection from completion.

repair-quality.title: E7: preservation and partial repair
repair-quality.note: Implemented; temporary removal is effort, not final damage.

difficulty.title: E8: length and access
difficulty.note: Length bands are current. Access calibration and empirical difficulty require independent evidence.

multi-events.title: E9: repeated incidents
multi-events.note: Implemented event windows end before the next external incident; short retention windows are N/A.

checkpoint.title: E10: supplied checkpoints
checkpoint.note: Planned separate bank; system-supplied progress is not model-built progress.

modality.title: E11: static input representation
modality.note: Planned adapters. First three compare native interfaces with unequal perceptual information; last three encode identical facts and test representation/OCR. Keep family and visibility strata; never pool the two studies.

action-output.title: E12: localization interface
action-output.note: Current handles are implemented; coordinate variants require matched action domains.

perception-probe.title: E13: independent detection
perception-probe.note: Planned independent snapshot bank; no label inferred from episode failure.

cross-recovery.title: E14: repair of another agent state
cross-recovery.note: Planned shared failed-state bank with matched checkpoints and no hidden reference access.

visual-robustness.title: E15: observation robustness
visual-robustness.note: Planned controlled visual variants; recheck visibility and legality.

strategy-budget.title: E16: planning and budget
strategy-budget.note: Planned study; charge all decisions and queries, and change one budget at a time.

efficiency.title: E17: effort and cost
efficiency.note: Implemented logging. Reference is feasible, not optimal; retry costs remain included.

human-panel.title: E18: independent human study
human-panel.note: Planned. GT review is not blind ability evidence; responses must be independent.

failures.title: E19: validity ledger
failures.note: Implemented status separation. Planned and valid denominators are both reported.

policy-baselines.title: E20: reference and simple policies
policy-baselines.note: Planned common-task controls. Witness uses private state and is a feasibility check, never a fair learned-agent competitor. All aggregate cells remain unmeasured.

diagnostic-assistance.title: E21: assistance ladder
diagnostic-assistance.note: Planned diagnostics with increasing privileged information; report assistance explicitly. These conditions cannot replace the public-input leaderboard.

observation-latency.title: E22: observing and recovering
observation-latency.note: Planned postprocessing: delay to first fresh current image after an event, not detection time. Recovery@k retains early terminal outcomes and censors a subsequent event before k; report horizon coverage.

incident-dose.title: E23: incident stage and magnitude
incident-dose.note: Planned controlled incident variants. Stage is measured by actual correct installed fraction; requalify solvability after every change.

scorer-invariance.title: E24: scorer invariance
scorer-invariance.note: Planned scored paired audit; known existing checks do not populate a new aggregate automatically. Preserve final geometry and constraints for invariant pairs; wrong finals must be rejected.

physical-agreement.title: E25: independent action adjudication
physical-agreement.note: Planned independent expert or separate-engine verdicts. False acceptance divides by independently invalid actions; false rejection divides by independently valid actions. Unresolved cases remain separate.

visibility-audit.title: E26: evidence usability
visibility-audit.note: Planned independent review with only model-visible evidence. Count recoverably occluded and never-visible cases separately; agreement after showing GT is not blind performance.

source-generalization.title: E27: source and object coverage
source-generalization.note: Planned external-source study; newly acquired sources must be absent from authoring and tuning. Current test labels alone do not establish novelty.

aggregation-uncertainty.title: E28: aggregation and eligibility
aggregation-uncertainty.note: Planned source-cluster bootstrap with one run per condition. Intervals describe source sampling, not model sampling variance; all-attempt view reports technical exclusions without scoring them as ability failures.

matched-transfer.title: E29: same-state static-to-dynamic comparison
matched-transfer.note: Planned 2x2 study at an actually reached faulty state. Match target, inventory, candidate domain, images and remaining budget; retain separate total-budget sensitivity.

trajectory-progress.title: E30: progress and stopping
trajectory-progress.note: Planned full-trace postprocessing. Mean and peak F1 use actual operable states; external edits split stall segments. Completion and episode length must accompany averages to avoid rewarding early termination.

dynamic-modality.title: E31: dynamic input representation
dynamic-modality.note: Planned adapters. No initial scene or automatic refresh after a move. Qualify normal success within each modality; report common-qualified objects and matched-state transfer separately.

mechanism-probes.title: E32: separate evidence and action demands
mechanism-probes.note: Planned separate checkpoint probes. Answers are not injected into primary episodes; assistance changes the contract and does not prove a unique internal cause.
